snippet.title: Zombie God | Early Access Trailer
snippet.description:
Zombie God: A strategy game with a roguelike twist.

It’s time for the zombies to take revenge. Humanity has been happy for far too long, use your arsenal of unholy powers, mutated zombies, and destructive totems to put humanity back in its place in this strategy roguelike game.

🕹Available now on Steam!

Links:
🔗 Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3035320/Zombie_God/
🔗 Official Website: https://zombiegodgame.com
🔗 Discord: https://discord.gg/jCpv5xMG
